name: Zaply.me – Video Reviews & UGC for WooCommerce
author: zaplyme

sections.description:
Zaply.me turns your customers into a source of authentic video content.
After an order is completed, the plugin sends a friendly invitation to record a short
vertical video review. When you approve the video, the customer automatically gets a
reward coupon – so more customers record, and you get more UGC for ads, product pages
and social media.

Why stores use Zaply.me

  • More trust on product pages – real people showing your product beat star ratings.
  • Ready-made ad creatives – vertical 9:16 videos with captions for Reels, TikTok and Meta Ads.
  • Automatic rewards – a WooCommerce coupon is sent only after you approve the video.
  • No app for the customer – they record in the browser from a link in the email.
  • Your mail, your brand – invitations go out through your WooCommerce mailer.

How it works

  1. Connect your store with your Zaply.me company slug.
  2. Set the invitation delay (e.g. 7 days after “Completed”) and the coupon value.
  3. Customers record a video from the link in the email.
  4. You approve the best videos in Zaply.me and download them.

Good fit for

Natural cosmetics, pet accessories, shoes, bags and jewellery – any product that looks better in a customer’s hands.

Privacy

Customer email addresses are not sent to the Zaply.me API by this plugin. Review invitations and reward emails are sent by your WooCommerce mailer. See “External services” below for the full list of data the plugin sends and receives.

External services

This plugin connects to the Zaply.me service, which is required for it to work. Zaply.me hosts the page where customers record video reviews and the dashboard where the store approves them. The plugin does not contact the production API from local or development sites (localhost, private IP addresses, or the WordPress environment types “local” and “development”).

Zaply.me API (https://api.zaply.me)

  • Connecting the store – when you save or change the company slug, or click “Reconnect” in Settings → Zaply.me, the plugin sends a POST request to https://api.zaply.me/v1/integrations/woocommerce/register with the company slug and the store URL. The API returns a shared secret, which the plugin stores and uses to authenticate later requests in both directions.
  • Registering an order – when an order is paid or reaches the “Completed” status, and again when the delayed invitation is about to be sent, the plugin sends a POST request to https://api.zaply.me/v1/orders/register with the company slug, the WooCommerce order ID, and the customer’s billing first name (or billing last name if the first name is empty, otherwise the word “Klient”). The API returns a token used to build the customer’s review link and tells the plugin whether invitations are allowed (they are allowed only after the store’s review terms URL is set in Zaply.me).
  • All requests use HTTPS with SSL verification and include the shared secret in the X-Zaplyme-Secret header.

Review link (https://zaply.me)

The invitation email contains a link to https://zaply.me/r/{company-slug}?order={order ID}&token={token}. When the customer opens it, the video is recorded and stored by Zaply.me, not by your WordPress site.

Incoming notifications from Zaply.me

The plugin registers the REST route /wp-json/zaplyme/v1/video-approved (also available as /index.php?rest_route=/zaplyme/v1/video-approved). After you approve a video in Zaply.me, the service calls this route with the order ID and the customer’s consent choice for using the video. Requests without a valid X-Zaplyme-Secret header are rejected. The plugin then sends the reward email with the coupon.

What is not sent

The plugin does not send customer email addresses, phone numbers, postal addresses, order items, or payment data to Zaply.me. Review and reward emails are sent by your store’s WooCommerce mailer and can be disabled individually in WooCommerce → Settings → Emails.

This service is provided by Zaply.me: Terms of Service, Privacy Policy.
sections.faq:
Do I need a Zaply.me account?

Yes. Create one at https://zaply.me – setup takes a few minutes.

Does the customer need to install an app?

No. The video is recorded in the mobile browser.

When is the invitation sent?

After the order is paid or reaches the “Completed” status, once the delay you set in Settings → Zaply.me has passed (in minutes; default 5). Each order gets only one invitation.

Can I choose which videos get a reward?

Yes. The coupon is sent only after you approve the video.

Can I use the videos in ads?

Yes, within the consent the customer gives in your review terms (configured in Zaply.me).

Does it work with my theme?

The plugin works in the background (orders and emails) and does not change your storefront.

What information is sent to Zaply.me?

When you connect the store: the company slug and the store URL. For each eligible order: the company slug, the order ID, and the customer’s billing first name (or last name if the first name is empty). The customer’s email address is not sent to the Zaply.me API by this plugin. See “External services” for details.

Where are customer emails sent from?

From your store. Review invitations and reward emails are sent by WooCommerce through your store’s configured mail transport (for example your SMTP plugin), using your WooCommerce email styling. You can edit or disable both emails in WooCommerce → Settings → Emails.

Is it available in Polish?

Yes. Since version 1.0.2 the plugin includes a Polish translation (pl_PL) of the settings screen, order notes, and both customer emails. It is used automatically when your site language is set to Polish.
